kanpur-1999.notes: Source 1's copy (1 page saved of 25 addresses) is the home page of the 2000 edition (contest_named: ACM ICPC 2000 Asia Region - Kanpur Site; belongs_to: kanpur-2000). Its nav links to acm99.html ('acm ICPC 1999'), which was not fetched and would be the page for this contest.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw a crawl seeded on the 2001 home page and assigned it to kanpur-2001; our replaced copy holds only the 2000 home page, so it belongs to kanpur-2000.
sources.evidence: The only page in our copy is 'ACM ICPC-2000: Home' of the ICPC 2000 Asia Region - Kanpur Site, 'Event On : 15 & 16 December 2000', last modified December 19, 2000; it only links to a separate 'acm ICPC 1999' page that is not in the copy.

kanpur-2019.notes: All ten CodeChef copies (captured 2026-11-22) are real practice problem pages with statements, but none of them mentions ICPC, Kanpur, a contest code or a date anywhere in the HTML; only PRMPRT carries a letter ("B - Prime-partite Graph"). Verdict cannot-tell: the tie to the 2019 Kanpur regional must come from another source (e.g. a CodeChef contest page listing these codes). If a human confirms the link, the pages can be described as plain problem pages. Second check: all ten pages list the same author account, msi_cse_buet, under Contributors, which suggests a BUET (Dhaka) problem-setting account rather than a Kanpur one; worth confirming these codes really belong to Kanpur 2019.

kanpur-2020.notes: The live capture of kanpur.indiaicpc.in/Result.pdf (2026-11-22) got HTTP 200 with content-type text/html: the site now answers that address with its 2026 front page, so the 2020 online-contest results PDF is not in our copy. A Wayback capture of the PDF from around 2021 is needed.

sources.evidence: The file saved as Result.pdf is not a PDF but an HTML page titled "ICPC Kanpur Regional 2026 | Registration, Dates and Onsite Centres" (the 2026 regional's front page, served in place of the missing file), with no 2020 results.

kanpur-2025.notes: None of the 11 CodeChef problem pages names the contest; the link to Kanpur 2025 rests on the letters A-K matching the 11-problem count and on the catalogue. The CodeChef contest page ICPCKANRP25 held in the archive is an empty app shell. Titles by letter: A Array Balancing, B Bicycle Coloring, C Edge Elimination, D Empty Intersection, E Merging Maximum, F Minimize Minimum, G Penny Pinching, H Prefix Game, I Prefix MEX Equation, J Recursion, K Tree Hail Conjecture (pack has no letters to compare).
